sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Wholesale Trade of Aged Scotch and Bordeaux Wines

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (based on Spanish Civil Law tradition, combined with codified Commercial Law and modern corporate statutes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States – Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (Investment Chapter)
Panama – United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty
Panama – Republic of Korea Investment Promotion and Protection Treaty

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT Law) and its enabling regulations; Ley No. 52 de 27 de agosto de 2016 (Beneficial Ownership of Legal Entities) as amended by Ley No. 129 de 18 de diciembre de 2020; Acuerdos and Resoluciones of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), including the mandatory Corporate and Trust Due-Diligence Regulation; Transparency and Beneficial Ownership Registry Directives issued by the Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport or national identification of each proposed shareholder, director, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Civil Registry or Passport Office of the individual's jurisdiction of nationality/residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal records certificate for each proposed director, senior officer, and each natural person holding or controlling 10% or more of the corporate capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Police or Designated Criminal Records Bureau of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where the issuing state is not party to the Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized corporate power of attorney appointing the Panamanian Resident Agent and accepting the purchase of the corporate shelf or newly formed Sociedad Anónima
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary in the jurisdiction of the ultimate corporate shareholder (if any)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of corporate existence and good standing of any corporate shareholder, together with its own UBO list certified by the corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry / Corporate Registrar of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular folio if from a non-Hague jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized source of funds declaration and bank reference letter for the initial paid-in capital and expected working funds for the bonded wine/spirit trade
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR bank attestation certified by the local notary and authenticated

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence under Ley 23 de 2015 and UAF Resolution No. 2-2017: each proposed shareholder, director, and beneficial owner shall be screened against the OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Sanctions Lists, EU/UK consolidated sanctions, and the Panamanian national PEP and sanctions database. Any positive PEP or adverse media match triggers mandatory reporting to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and the transaction is subject to heightened scrutiny. For a bonded wine/spirits trading entity, the AML/CFT risk classification is Medium-Risk-Enhanced, requiring a documented source-of-funds and commercial-reasonableness review for each formation payment.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Oficina en Línea / Servicio de Consulta de Sociedades (https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the Civil Registration system, the proposed corporate name must be submitted in Spanish, or in a Latin-character transliteration if a foreign-word token is used. The name shall be intelligible in the Spanish language and may include mixed terms provided the transliteration is coherent and does not create a false impression of Government endorsement or regulated financial/services activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a negative name clearance by the Public Registry, the applicant or the licensed Resident Agent may file an administrative 'Recurso de Reconsideración' before the Director of the Public Registry (Registro Público) within 5 business days of notification, attaching a revised name request and arguments of distinctiveness. If reconsideration is denied, an administrative appeal ('Recurso de Apelación') is available to the Higher Tribunal (Tercera Superior) within 10 business days. Alternatively, the applicant may initiate a new name-availability search with a different name at any time without penalty.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office can be maintained at the address of the licensed Resident Agent for corporate law compliance, and a virtual office arrangement is acceptable for meeting the registered-agency formality. However, for a bonded warehouse wholesale trade of wine and spirits, the physical licensed operating facility must be a custom-approved bonded warehouse with a distinct, lease-appointed physical address. A virtual office will not satisfy the tax, customs, and health authority requirements for the liquor importation and bonded distribution licenses.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (85%) – unannounced on-site physical inspections are routine for bonded wine/spirit warehouses under customs and excise supervision, and will be executed at the operational address registered with the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas de Panamá (ANA), the General Directorate of Revenue (DGI), and Ministry of Health liquor licensing division.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name availability search and reservation fee (Registro Público de Panamá)
Drafting of Articles of Incorporation (Pacto Social) and statutory corporate by-laws (Estatuto)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard Panama S.A. formation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the deed of incorporation before a Panamanian Public Notary
Registration of the Public Deed at the Mercantile Section of the Registro Público de Panamá
Resident agent and registered office service for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian resident agent (corporation service provider)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO initial declaration preparation and filing with the Beneficial Ownership Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (via licensed agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff plus agent service fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN and UAF sanctions screening and AML/KYC compliance file compilation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML compliance officer / corporate due diligence consultant

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of foreign-issuer UBO/identity documents (estimated per full bundle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Consular office of Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular fee (variable) plus courier costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Law No. 32 of 1927, as amended), Articles 1-100, together with Executive Decrees and Regulations applicable to the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) registered with the Panama Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Sociedad Anónima is authorized to have nominal capital of at least USD 10,000, but no capital must be paid in, deposited, or escrowed at incorporation; one subscriber/shareholder may incorporate, and shares may be issued at no par value.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [Company], adopted by unanimous written consent in accordance with the Company's Bylaws. The Board resolves: (1) the subscriptions to the Company's authorized capital are accepted, and each subscriber shall receive the number of shares set opposite their name in the Company's share register; (2) the registered office at [address], Panama City, Republic of Panama, is adopted, and the resident agent therein is ratified; (3) [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Treasurer, and [Name] Secretary, each to hold office until the next annual general meeting; (4) the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute bonded-warehouse agreements, and file all business and industrial license applications. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama Public Registry (Registro Público de Panamá), Mercantile Section, online e-RPP portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three alternative corporate names intended for the Sociedad Anónima, pay the search fee, and obtain a Certificate of Name Availability. The selected name must include 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity.
required_dossiers: Petitioner identity document or counsel authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is reserved by another entity, file a reconsideration with a substitute name or withdraw and submit a fresh list; no substantive prejudice is incurred.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Public Deed before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the First Circuit, Panama City, accredited by the Supreme Court of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Legal counsel prepares the articles of incorporation and bylaws. The incorporator(s) appear before the notary, declare their intention to incorporate the S.A., acknowledge the share subscriptions, and execute the Escritura Pública. The notary issues the first notarial copy after completing protocolization.
required_dossiers: Draft Public Deed and Articles of Incorporation
Passport or national identification copies of subscribers
Acceptance letters of officers and resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial objections are cured by amending the deed, executing an addendum, or re-executing the document with corrected recitals and renewed acknowledgments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Public Deed with the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, Mercantile Section, Central Registry Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the first notarial copy and supporting documents with the Mercantile Section. Pay the registration and stamp charges. The registry examiner verifies legal compliance and, upon approval, records the company in the Folio Mercantil and issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of the Public Deed
Sworn declarations of acceptance by directors and resident agent
Power of attorney or legal engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an observation ('razón'), counsel files a corrective brief or a corrected instrument within the ten-business-day cure term; once cured, the inscription is effective as of the initial presentation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Resident Agent and Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, Legalization Office, and licensed resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the appointment of a licensed resident agent and register the shareholder register, board minute book, and stock ledger. Order the corporate seal and request a Certified Copy of the Public Deed and Certificate of Good Standing.
required_dossiers: Appointment of resident agent signed by the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resident agent fails to qualify, the company substitutes the agent by filing an amendment under delegated authority and re-certifies the corporate records with the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating Notice and Taxpayer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama, Dirección de Rentas Municipales; Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) for RUC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty days of registration, apply for the Aviso de Operación for wholesale bonded warehouse activity and obtain the RUC from the DGI. Submit the classification of the business activity to enable subsequent customs and bonded-warehouse authorizations.
required_dossiers: Lease or ownership title of the warehouse
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal or DGI objections are cured by filing an amended sworn declaration, presenting updated certified corporate documents, or rectifying the economic activity classification; appeals are available to the municipal tax authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) - Dirección General de Salud, Dirección de Regulación Sanitaria
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento para Depósito Fiscal de Bebidas Alcohólicas and Aviso de Operación (Municipal)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II (moderate impact) - a full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EsIA) / environmental impact assessment and an environmental management plan are required for the bonded warehouse and bulk wine and spirit storage.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must meet Panamanian effluent standards: pH 6-9; BOD5 no greater than 50 mg/L; COD no greater than 150 mg/L; total suspended solids no greater than 50 mg/L. VOC and ethanol vapor emissions must be captured by vapor balancing or activated carbon filtration; hazardous alcohol waste must be manifested and transported to a licensed hazardous-waste facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection certificate from Bomberos de Panamá; structural and racking-load inspection certificate issued by a licensed engineer covering warehouse floor loading capacity; and workplace safety clearance from Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) covering emergency exits, spill containment, and hazardous-material handling.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), Panama; official e-portals: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa (Sede Electrónica) and the DGI Sistema de Facturación Electrónica; customs counterpart: Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) via SIGA Web (https://siga.ana.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident owners incorporate a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) by notarial Escritura Pública, with a resident agent (Agente Residente) and at least three directors, then record the deed at the Registro Público de Panamá. Thereafter obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación (business license) and fire-department (SUMEI) clearance for the bonded premises. File the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) application at the DGI Sede Electrónica, attaching the registered deed, resident-agent acceptance, municipal license, and legal-representative identification; the DGI issues a 14-digit RUC with ITBMS and income-tax registration. Finally, for bonded wine/spirits wholesale trade, apply to the ANA for the depósito aduanero (bonded warehouse) license and register for SIGA Web customs declarations and SFE electronic invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists. Elective regimes available: (i) SEM Multinational Headquarters regime (Law 41 of 2007) with DGI certification; (ii) special economic zones (Panama Pacifico, City of Knowledge, Colon Free Zone) requiring ANA/DGI approvals; (iii) simplified small-taxpayer regime if annual gross income is PAB 36,000 or less; (iv) DGI-approved fiscal consolidation (consolidado) for related taxpayers; (v) BEPS-aligned anti-hybrid rules introduced by Law 254 of 2021 govern hybrid mismatch outcomes (no domestic election; treatment follows counterpart jurisdiction characterization).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (ITBMS — Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), Código Fiscal Art. 105 et seq., as amended by Law 25 of 2010
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general de minimis threshold: every entity performing taxable transfers in Panama must register for ITBMS. Small-taxpayer simplified regime is optional when annual gross taxable turnover is PAB 36,000 (approx. USD 36,000) or less; bonded-warehouse wholesale trade requires mandatory full registration irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Factura Electrónica under Law 256 of 2021 and DGI Resolution No. 201-4648 (as amended). Invoices must be issued through the DGI Sistema de Facturación Electrónica (SFE), transmitted real-time via Sede Electrónica or certified API, validated with an Acuse de Recibo and QR code; legacy physical fiscal stamps are abolished. Bonded wine/spirits operators must integrate SFE invoices with ANA SIGA Web export declarations and warehouse removal orders; cross-authority data matching applies. Large taxpayers were phased in first; all B2B taxpayers are mandatory by CY2025.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% ITBMS applies to exports of goods, including bonded wine/spirits physically shipped abroad under ANA supervision. Eligibility criteria: valid RUC and bonded-warehouse license; SIGA export declaration filed; goods exported within the ANA-authorized bonded removal period and not released for domestic consumption; buyer is a non-resident; title transfers outside Panama; sale documented with an SFE zero-rated invoice; export proceeds remitted into Panama and evidenced; and input ITBMS credits are fully substantiated. Domestic release from the bonded warehouse is taxed at 7% on the customs-duty-inclusive value.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única de Mercancías / DAM filed via ANA SIGA Web)
Bill of Lading (or air waybill) evidencing foreign destination and Panamanian exit port
Commercial Invoice and zero-rated SFE/ITBMS invoice with DGI validation QR code
Packing List and container/vehicle movement documents
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank credit/SWIFT confirmation evidencing receipt of export proceeds from the non-resident buyer)
Bonded warehouse removal/re-export authorization issued by ANA for the specific spirits/wine lots
Certificate of Origin (optional, retained for customs audit and tariff purposes)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and ANA jointly audit zero-rate claims; failure to prove physical export, submission of false declarations, or non-repatriation of proceeds within 180 days (unless a DGI extension is granted) triggers reassessment at 7% ITBMS plus statutory interest (currently approx. 10% p.a.), fines up to 200% of the tax evaded under Art. 762 Código Fiscal, suspension or revocation of the bonded-warehouse license, customs penalties including goods forfeiture, and criminal liability for tax evasion under Law 70 of 2019 (imprisonment and monetary penalties). Administrative defense before the DGI and appeal to the Tribunal Administrativo Tributario (TAT) remain available.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no issuing central bank; the monetary regime is full legal-tender dollarization. Banking and AML/CFT supervision rests with the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); the Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) acts as the State's fiscal agent and operates settlement for the national clearing system. The Panamanian Balboa (PAB) exists only as divisional coins at fixed 1:1 parity with the United States dollar (USD).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized, exchange-control-free regime. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible with no central-bank approval, no exchange declaration, and no profit-remittance licensing or registration. Dividends, interest, capital redemptions, and trade proceeds may be remitted abroad through ordinary commercial bank instructions; the only practical hurdles are documentary, namely source-of-funds verification, UBO confirmation, and DGI tax-compliance declarations. Because the USD is the domestic circulating currency, inbound investment and outbound disbursements settle in USD without monetary conversion; however, trade payables denominated in EUR and GBP expose the treasury to leg-level FX risk.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panamanian law imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender requirement for export proceeds. A bonded-trade vehicle may retain 100% of collections in USD or any freely convertible currency, onshore or offshore. The Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) requires only documentary reconciliation of goods admitted to and removed from the duty-suspension bonded warehouse; it does not monitor or compel repatriation of the associated proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD current account, cash management portal)
Operational Account plus Documentary Import LC (MT700) Trade Finance Line
Operational Account with Foreign Trade and Bonded Warehouse Service Desk

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax (Impuesto Anual de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Impuestos del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (DGI-MEF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Full payment by March 15; or equal installments due March 15, June 15, and September 15 for the respective calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge plus monthly statutory interest on the unpaid amount; company denied clean tax certificate and unavailable for notarial or registry filings; continued non-payment triggers administrative strike-off and loss of legal standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 15 of the following fiscal year for calendar-year taxpayers; if fiscal year differs, due on the last day of the third month after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of USD 100 (or actual tax due if higher); plus 10% recargo on unpaid tax and monthly statutory interest; penalty increases for inaccurate declarations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Registry Confirmation (Registro de Titularidad Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Impuestos (DGI-MEF) – Registro de Titularidad Final
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any change in ultimate beneficial ownership; annual confirmation with the income tax return calendar (due by March 15 for calendar-year entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 10,000 per violation for a juridical person; suspension of rights before DGI and public registry certificates until compliance is restored

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business Operation Notice Renewal (Aviso de Operación)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Impuestos (DGI-MEF) – National Taxpayer Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 45 calendar days of the fiscal year (typically January–February for calendar-year entities); exact annual date based on the corporate anniversary of the Aviso
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of USD 100 to USD 500 depending on delay; risk of temporary closure of commercial premises for failure to display the renewed notice; continued absence leads to DGI flagging and bank/lockdown restrictions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A licensed independent audit is mandatory if annual gross turnover exceeds USD 3 million, total assets exceed USD 1 million, or if the exempt/regulated bonded-warehouse license requires audited financial statements under the Panama Customs Authority (ANA) or the Superintendencia de Mercado de Valores requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama (NIIF) is required for publicly accountable entities; other entities may apply full IFRS or the simplified framework for small and medium-sized entities (NIIF para PYMES), as accepted by the DGI and the Registro Público.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain the UBO record and file an annual confirmation with DGI identifying all natural persons with direct or indirect ownership of 10% or more, control through board composition, or beneficial ownership by management or other means. Any transfer of shares requiring UBO change is disclosed within 30 days to DGI, and the annual confirmation certifies the updated shareholding register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shares and Transfer Ledger
Minute Book of Shareholders and Directors

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,500 for a medium entirely or medium-sized trading entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama applies a territorial tax regime; qualifying activities may access tax benefits under the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime, and bonded warehouse operators in wine/spirits trade benefit from suspension of import duties and ITBMS (VAT) on bonded movements. No preferential corporate income tax rate applies to general trading activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 103 (Declaración Anual de Renta - Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the DGI (Dirección General de Ingresos) e-Tax portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months following the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, deadline is 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from Panamanian-source wholesale sales, including bonded warehouse deliveries and domestic sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income sourced in Panama; foreign-source sales outside Panama are excluded under territorial taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold for wine and spirits, including bonded storage costs, excise taxes, and customs duties recovered on sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only costs incurred for generating Panamanian-source revenue; allocate costs consistently with arm's length principles.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses attributable to Panamanian bonded trade, including rent, salaries, freight, insurance, and other ordinary expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide supporting documentation; expenses attributable to non-Panamanian branches or activities must be excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net territory-sourced income before credits and prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute based on territorial rules; transactions with related parties must be priced at arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance income tax payments, withholding tax credits, and other allowable credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may claim Panama withholding tax credits on distributions only if disclosed and supported by DGI certificates.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of 10% of the total tax due plus monthly interest at the DGI rate (currently 10% per annum); fixed fines up to USD 5,000 for non-filing or incomplete filing; criminal exposure for fraud.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its jurisdiction of residence, (ii) submit the TRC along with Form 104 ('Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario del Exterior') to the Panamanian withholding agent before each dividend payment, and (iii) provide a legal opinion or treaty analysis if requested by the DGI. The withholding agent shall retain copies and remit the reduced rate only if treaty conditions are met; failure to comply results in full 10% withholding plus surcharges.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates: royalties 10% and interest on foreign loans 10%. Under Panama's limited double tax agreements (e.g., with Mexico, South Korea, and the Netherlands), treaty rates may be reduced to 5% or 0% interest and royalties, provided the beneficial owner submits the required TRC and Form 104 evidence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 2,000,000 in balboas (1:1 with USD) of gross income in the preceding tax year triggers mandatory Local File and Master File requirements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable under Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 254 of 2021). A bonds-wholesale wine/spirits entity engaged in supply-chain distribution is classified as a 'distribution and service center' relevant activity; it must demonstrate all core income-generating activities (inventory management, order processing, negotiation, and shipping) are performed in Panama, with physical premises, qualified local employees, and proportionate operating expenditure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting Panamanian-source bonded warehouse sales or using fictitious foreign invoices to shift profits and avoid 25% corporate tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panama Tax Code (Código Fiscal), evasion attracts fines of 100% of the omitted tax, interest at 10% per annum, and criminal penalties of up to five years imprisonment; the DGI may also suspend operating licenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally and jointly liable for uncovered tax debt through piercing of the corporate veil; civil restitution orders, asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment for willful participation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a bonded wine/spirits entity with no physical office, no local employees, and no actual management in Panama while claiming territorial tax benefits and distributing profits to non-residents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law 254 of 2021 sanctions range from USD 50,000 to USD 750,000 for failure to comply with economic substance requirements; additional penalties for late filing of the annual ESR report; loss of bonded warehouse license and customs operating privileges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined and disqualified from holding corporate roles; travel restrictions may be imposed to compel appearance in administrative proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large volumes of cash or third-party payments without customer due diligence in connection with wine/spirits bonded transfers, particularly when funds originate from smuggling or organized crime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 23 of 2015 and UAF resolutions, fines up to USD 5,000,000 and suspension or revocation of the legal entity authorization; criminal liability for money laundering under the Penal Code carries imprisonment up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers criminally liable for willful failure to report suspicious transactions; personal asset confiscation and travel bans pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using non-arm's length commissions, management fees, loans, or product pricing with related distributors in high-tax jurisdictions without maintaining contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI may adjust taxable income and impose penalties between 10% and 40% of the adjustment amount, plus interest at 10% per annum; failure to file TP report (Form 113) adds separate fines up to USD 10,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign inaccurate TP returns face personal liability for adjustments and penalties; in severe cases, criminal prosecution for fraudulent misrepresentation may lead to imprisonment and travel bans.
